news.title: Madhav Rajan reappointed as dean of UChicago’s Booth School of Business
news.summary_en: Madhav Rajan has been reappointed for a third term as the Steven S. Wymer Dean of the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, President Paul Alivisatos and Provost Katherine Baicker announced.
